changelog:
ai-ethics-check 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Launches a free AI ethics compliance check tool based on the 2026 China MIIT guidelines.
- Covers 10 key compliance items with both cloud-scoring and full offline preview modes.
- Anonymous trial (5 free runs) available without registration; free API Key offers 100 runs after signup.
- Scoring and report generation handled by the complianceHub cloud; no personal accounts or billing in terminal.
- User answers are transmitted to compliancehub.cn for scoring (offline mode never sends data).
- Plain, detailed legal and security disclosures included; installation and usage are free.
